title: devteam review --json
description: Zero-install external review entry point (Phase 36 item 36.4, plans/phase-36-external-review-mode.md §36.4). Wraps core/driver.js run()'s summary (snake_case, same convention) with the workspace/host-honesty facts specific to this command: which workspace the review's state landed in, which host dispatched it (and whether that host mechanically enforces read-only review), and where the 35.4 findings report was written. core/cli/commands/review.js is the authoritative producer; this file documents the same contract.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this JSON shape, independent of driver.js's own RUN_SCHEMA_VERSION.

path.description: Absolute path to the subject being reviewed.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the review workspace (stateRoot) — where every gate, artifact, and log for this run landed.

host.description: Dispatch host used for this run.

review_mode_enforced.description: True only when --host is acp — the only host that mechanically prevents writes into the subject (hosts/acp/permissions.js). False means enforcement degraded to a post-hoc audit; --allow-unenforced-writes was required to reach this run.

findings_report.description: Null only when the run errored before a findings report could be generated.
